He bowed his head and began to say a prayer, but interrupted himself — touching his lover's beard, then his hands for the last time. His crying was now audible as the undertaker helped him from the kneeler and back to his seat.
1986, Craig G. Harris, “Cut Off from Among Their People”, in Joseph Beam, editor, In The Life: A Black Gay Anthology, page 66:
Of course they would come. Of course they would get kneebound. People enjoy an honest-to-God prayer meeting in good times and bad.
2009, Stephen King, Under the Dome:
Fear is what puts butts into pews, what knocks us kneebound as if by the baton of a slavedriver.
